name: IONOS

nonStandard.description: IONOS market of the domain, for example "de"; urlSyncUX and urlAsyncUX point to that market's host.

notes: Every domain registered at IONOS gets the CNAME record _domainconnect -> _domainconnect.ionos.com by default (domains registered before January 2022 may point to _domainconnect.1and1.com, with the same function). The settings response returns width and height as strings (for example "800"), where the specification defines numbers.
